publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Scientific algorithmic anatomical or condition reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, patient record, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplies controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH or HHS sources constrain conservative representation. No source composition is copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, conservative non-diagnostic anatomy or timing orientation, non-stigmatizing communication, complete pale edge field, crop-safe geometry, and exact prompt frozen before exactly one generation call per cleared route. Every PNG was inspected at native 1536 by 1024 resolution; observed output controls later metadata.
promotionRule: Only the six exact accepted source hashes were promoted to metadata-bearing lossless masters, article WebP derivatives, and centered contain-mode 1200x630 social WebP derivatives.
